subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Efficacy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"efficacy"** means the ability to produce a desired or intended result. (प्रभावकारिता)

 
 
• **Example:** The **efficacy** of the new drug was proven through rigorous clinical trials.
 
 
 
• **"Efficiency"** refers to the ability to accomplish something with the least waste of time and effort; competency in performance. (कुशलता)
 
 
• **Example:** The** efficiency **of the new machine has greatly increased our production rate.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'efficacy'** is **'efficiency'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Urgency** (आपातकालीन स्थिति): The need for quick action or attention.

 
 
• **Example:** The urgency of the situation required immediate intervention.
 
 
 
• **Conspiracy** (साज़िश): A secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful.
 
 
• **Example:** The conspiracy was uncovered before any harm could be done.
 
 
 
• **Ecstasy** (परमानंद): An overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement.
 
 
• **Example:** She was in ecstasy after hearing the news of her promotion.
 
 

 

128:Tbb0,

The correct answer is: **Option 4.**
